thread:
Alex K.: Quick idea — we should standardize postmortem follow-ups into a small, repeatable template. recurring incidents keep slipping through the cracks.
Trina (SRE): yes please. current adhoc follow-ups are hard to track.
Samir - Eng: Agree. Anything we do should link to a ticket in our tracker automatically.
Lee PM: Curious about cadence — what are you thinking for timing and comms?
Alex K.: Proposed 'Action Radar' template: short, machine-friendly and human-readable. three buckets: IMMEDIATE / SHORT / LONG. e.g.
```
IMMEDIATE (0-24h): owner, rollback or mitigation, comms status
SHORT (7d): triage, root-cause hypotheses, infra fixes, small PRs
LONG (30-90d): follow-up projects, perf regresses, audits, recurring pattern review
```
Alex K.: Also add a 90-day "pattern review" to detect repeats and assign a doc owner.
Emily Ops: For comms I'd propose: initial ack in 15–60m, internal debrief within 24h, public/noisy customer update within 72h if impacted. keep it simple.
Trina (SRE): +1. And we should auto-create checklist tasks for 24h and 7d reminders. could tie into oncall-bot.
oncall-bot: Reminder rule created: postmortem-followup 24h and 7d pings (disabled by default). :gear:
Samir - Eng: For ownership: prefer explicit owner + fallback. e.g. `owner: alice; fallback: oncall-weekly`. avoids orphaned items.
Lee PM: Rotation question — do we want fixed incident commander rotation (2 weeks) or volunteer? My vote: 2-week rotation with a visible calendar.
Emily Ops: Rotation handoffs need a tiny template: current open incidents, ongoing remediation, blocked items, contact for infra access. one-liner each.
Alex K.: I can draft a minimal YAML/issue template and a short one-slide timeline for comms. volunteers to review?
Trina (SRE): I'll review the YAML and add automation hooks for creating tracker tickets.
Samir - Eng: I'll add the fallback owner logic and link to our issues template.
Lee PM: I'll update the on-call calendar page and add rotation rules.
Emily Ops: I'll own the comms blurb template and the 72h customer message template.
Alex K.: Cool — action items: 1) Alex draft template (by EOD Fri) 2) Trina automation 3) Samir fallback logic 4) Lee calendar 5) Emily comms. We'll run a 30-min sync next Tue to finalize.
Samir - Eng: tiny nit — include a "severity_impact" field in the template so action priority is clear.
Alex K.: good call, will add `severity_impact` and `estimated_risk` fields.
Trina (SRE): If we want to reduce noise, oncall-bot should only ping the owners, not whole channel.
Alex K.: Agreed. I'll update the draft to include who gets pinged at which stage.
Lee PM: Thanks team. this feels practical and not heavy. :thumbsup:
Emily Ops: If everyone is ok, I'll convert the comms template into a Notion snippet after we finalize.
Alex K.: OK closing thread for now — raised follow-up: 1793504123-ACTION. We'll track in the issue tracker.
note: Slack thread-style messages are in a single continuous string as required.
